question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses** the usage of resources in a specific context.**
 
• The appropriate** verb** should indicate the application or employment of resources effectively.
 
• "**Utilized**" fits well as it denotes the act of making practical and effective use of something, which aligns with the context of resource management.
 
• Other options ("**operated**", "**employed**", "**applied**") do not fit the context as precisely as "utilized".

The correct word for fill in the blanks no. 3 is " Because they frequently have an odour, essential oils are utilized in perfumery and food flavouring.."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Operated (संचालित): "Operated" **means to control the functioning of a machine, process, or system, which does not fit the context of resource management.
 
• **Employed (नियोजित): "Employed" **means to make use of someone or something for a particular purpose, which is close but not as accurate as "utilised".
 
• **Applied (लागू किया गया): "Applied"** means to put to practical use, which is not as fitting as "utilised" in this context.
